# apple_promoted_purchase_order (Resource)

Sets the order in which an app's promoted purchases appear on its App Store page. The list must name each of the app's promotions once. Destroying the resource leaves the order. Import it by app ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_promoted_purchase_order" "app" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
  promoted_purchase_ids = [
    apple_promoted_purchase.pro.id,
    apple_promoted_purchase.coins.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `promoted_purchase_ids` (List of String) IDs of the app's promoted purchases, in display order, e.g. `apple_promoted_purchase.example.id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_promoted_purchase_order.app
  identity = {
    app_id = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_promoted_purchase_order.app 1234567890
```
